title: Witness and countersigner directory
description: Shape of witnesses.json. Checks JSON Schema cannot express (alphabetical order, a key id listed at most once across the file, a row not declaring independence of itself) are enforced by capsule_emit.witness_directory.

statement_types_issued.description: Registered Evidence Bundle countersignature types this operator issues, e.g. countersign/v1.

independent_of.description: The operator's own declaration of parties it is under no common control with. A declaration, not a finding: a verifier computes the independence of each countersignature from its signer key, never from this list.

name.description: The operator's self-declared name. Rows are ordered by it.

endpoint.description: Absolute https URL of the service; no credentials, query, or fragment.

key_ids.description: Full 32-byte Ed25519 public keys, lowercase hex. More than one when the operator has rotated keys.

since.description: Date the row's service began issuing, YYYY-MM-DD.
